ldgsts_desc_forms_rebuild.completion_semantics: completion is tracked per-instruction by the standard control-word write-barrier on the LDGSTS itself (consumer waits the slot; silicon-validated). The nvcc LDGDEPBAR/DEPBAR.LE group idiom does NOT function in bare cubins (DEPBAR.LE passes immediately; group counter inert - likely requires nvcc ELF/reservedSmem attributes) and is unnecessary.
